# `tfctl auth` reference

Manage authentication with HCP Terraform.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl auth <subcommand> [options]
```

## Description

The `tfctl auth` command provides subcommands for managing authentication with HCP Terraform. Use these commands to log in, check authentication status, and manage authentication tokens.

## Subcommands

- [`login`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/auth/login) - Authenticate with HCP Terraform
- [`status`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/auth/status) - Check authentication status

## Examples

The following command authenticates with HCP Terraform:

```shell-session
$ tfctl auth login
```

The following command checks your current authentication status:

```shell-session
$ tfctl auth status
```

## Global flags

Refer to [Global flags reference](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli#global-flags) for information about flags you can use with all commands.
